units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>בעל נ׳</he> a believer in omens.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:5">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אע״פ שאין נ׳ יש סימן</he> although you must not make them an omen, they are a sign (presage); <cite ref="Chullin 95b:13">Ḥull. 95ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 95b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>כל נ׳ שאינו … אינו נ׳</he> an omen which is not proposed in the manner of Eliezer … (<cite ref="Genesis 24:13">Gen. XXIV, 13</cite>, sq.) or of Jonathan (<cite ref="I Samuel 14:9">I Sam. XIV, 9</cite>, sq.) is not considered a divination (in the sense of <cite ref="Leviticus 19:26">Lev. XIX, 26</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְחָשִׁים</he>. Tanḥ. Balak 4 <he>בעל נ׳</he>, v. supra.
